fix_code:
N = int(input()) - 1
digits = []
while N > 0:
    quotient = N // 5
    remainder = N % 5
    digits.append(remainder * 2)
    N = quotient
good_integer = digits[::-1]
good_integer = ''.join(map(str, good_integer))
print(good_integer)
